name: 衰败玻璃温室
scope: Independent unregistered room delivery; no deployment, player save access, core changes or parallel-delivery writes.
semantic_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact ensure_ascii=true JSON sorted rows [x,y,z,block_id,sorted_properties]
identity_algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON independent_identity, sort_keys=true, ensure_ascii=true, compact separators. Not an FT runtime catalog fingerprint.

native.environment: Independent Forge GameTest overworld only; no player saves or production instance
native.placement_flags: 18 = UPDATE_CLIENTS | UPDATE_KNOWN_SHAPE; setKnownShape(true), setKeepLiquids(false), matching FT core

preview.method: Final NBT reparsed into block faces from local vanilla client blockstates/models/textures; fixed plains foliage tint, simplified source-water surfaces; preview-only cutaway.

design_review.glass_shell_and_roof: Continuous glass envelope except deliberate north 3x3 entrance; roof checked across 255 cells.
design_review.plants: 78 persistent leaves, 10 supported mature crops on hydrated farmland, four bed shroomlights, 46 roof-anchored fixed-length vines, soil-supported flowers.
design_review.paths: Three-wide central dry aisle plus side circulation; north entrance and interior connected with native 0.6x1.8x0.6 player AABB.
design_review.water: Eight true sources, stone bottom and sealed side beds; 6118-cell halo per rotation contains no escaped liquid.
design_review.suspensions: Two dirt-filled trapdoor baskets and two hanging lanterns, each chained directly to continuous roof beams.
reference_adaptations: Three-wide central path stays dry; two sealed side troughs replace the exposed central channel.
The NBT preserves a continuous glass roof and shell; cutaways are preview-only.
Persistent leaves, hydrated mature crops, four bed-integrated shroomlights and age-25 hanging vines avoid decay, darkness and extension.
Vanilla potting table and composters replace concept-only bottles, sacks and wheelbarrow.

iteration_history.reason: UPDATE_ALL default placement before lighting settled caused wheat to drop; recorded rather than reported as pass.

iteration_history.changes: Added four shroomlights; matched existing FT production known-shape flags 18; settled light for 20 ticks, then forced neighbor checks and 200 further ticking ticks at midnight. All placement chunks force-tick.
